Players Committee card image of [[Finn]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of any starship or enclosed vehicle he is aboard as a passenger. May deploy as a 'react' to same location as your pilot (free if Poe or Rey). Once per game, may take Blaster Proficiency into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/finn.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
